description: Productivity page — interim shape after plan 2026-09-12-consolidate-local-orchestration-onto-conductor Phase 4 deleted the plan/task board and the coordinator dashboard (local orchestration now lives in the conductor). The page is one 'Productivity' heading over a vertically scrolling column of exactly three panels, all mounted at once with no sub-view tabs, no sub-view routing event and no page-mounted handshake. (1) Knowledge — the KnowledgeBrowser rendered inline (src/components/knowledge/): an FTS-only search input, an area-filter dropdown populated from the current hits, a submit button and a results list with click-to-expand rows. The Ctrl+Shift+E modal is mounted once globally at the App level (GlobalKnowledgeBrowser), so this page mounts no second copy and has no modal button. (2) File activity — the live dirty-worktree heatmap from coord's events.worktree.dirty.* snapshot, the live file-registry holders with per-file 'Request yield' actions, and the hot files / hot sessions tables for a selectable window; on an isolated runner the live heatmap section renders the shared CoordConnectionRequired notice instead. (3) Overlapping intents — coord's L2 visibility surface: agent pairs whose declared overlap paths intersect, read through the list_overlapping_intents Tauri command every 30 s. It keeps three facts distinct: ISOLATED (no coord configured — controls disabled, the notice explains why), UNKNOWN (no read has succeeded yet or the last read failed — the panel says UNKNOWN and shows the failure text verbatim; it never renders an empty list for a failed read) and EMPTY (a read succeeded and returned no pairs). Every coord-backed surface reads the shared CoordModeContext (config-derived, never a reachability probe) and holds its first request until get_coord_mode has answered.

groups.description: Four stacked sub-sections under one header with a time-window select and a Refresh button: the live dirty-worktree heatmap (coord snapshot; replaced by the CoordConnectionRequired notice on an isolated runner), the live file-registry snapshot grouped by holder with a per-file 'Request yield' action under a cooldown, the hot-files table and the hot-sessions table for the selected window. Polls the runner's own HTTP API on a 5 s cadence; a stale-data marker appears when a poll fails and the previous snapshot is still shown.

groups.description: Header with an 'Overlapping intents' heading, a count label and a Refresh button. The section carries data-overlap-mode = isolated | unknown | empty | rows, which is the panel's whole state in one attribute. The count label is a number ('N active' / '0 active') only after a read has succeeded; it reads 'unknown' before the first successful read or after a failed one, and 'off' on an isolated runner. Refresh is disabled while a read is in flight and on an isolated runner (tooltip from coordDisabledCopy, so it can never contradict the notice).
groups.name: Overlapping Intents Panel

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Overlapping Intents — UNKNOWN

target.label: Required element for Overlapping Intents — UNKNOWN

groups.description: data-overlap-mode=unknown. No read has succeeded yet, or the most recent read failed. An amber role=status block headed 'UNKNOWN' explains which of those it is; after a failure the thrown value is rendered verbatim through describeThrown (invoke() rejects with a plain string, so the cause is never discarded into a bare constant). Rows from an earlier successful read are NOT shown as current. This state, not an empty list, is what a failed read renders.
groups.name: Overlapping Intents — UNKNOWN

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Overlapping Intents — isolated runner

target.label: Required element for Overlapping Intents — isolated runner

groups.description: data-overlap-mode=isolated. CoordModeContext resolved a POSITIVE mode=isolated (no coord configured), so coord.agent_worktrees is structurally empty and the panel renders the shared CoordConnectionRequired notice — naming the surface and the actual cause (no account vs unreadable settings.json) with the in-app action where one exists — instead of implying 'no contention'. No read is issued in this mode.
groups.name: Overlapping Intents — isolated runner

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Overlapping Intents — empty

target.label: Required element for Overlapping Intents — empty

groups.description: data-overlap-mode=empty. A read SUCCEEDED and returned no pairs; only then does the panel state that there is no L2 contention right now, with the count label '0 active'.
groups.name: Overlapping Intents — empty

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Overlapping Intents — pairs listed

target.label: Required element for Overlapping Intents — pairs listed

groups.description: data-overlap-mode=rows. One card per agent pair (data-agent-a / data-agent-b), each showing both agents' ids in monospace with their free-text intents ('no intent declared' in italic when null) over the de-duplicated set of overlapping paths as code chips. Read-only: the panel takes no action on a pair.
groups.name: Overlapping Intents — pairs listed
